nodes.description: External initializer that wires up contract id and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE to _owner; guarded by initializer modifier.
Manager-only exit handler that RLP-decodes a sidechain log, validates the event signature and sender, then performs an arbitrary external call into rootToken.
Manager-only lockTokens override that immediately reverts (disabled feature).
Public constant role identifier used to gate exitTokens and lockTokens.
Public constant expected event signature/topic0 used to validate exit logs.
Initializable flag that records whether initialize has already been executed.
AccessControl private mapping(bytes32 => RoleData) holding role members and admin roles.
AccessControlMixin private revert message used by the only modifier.
Caller-controlled address returned by _msgSender and used in role checks.
Arbitrary external call Data(rootToken).setData(data) where both the target contract and calldata are attacker-influenced, executed before any state finalization.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue that forwards all gas to an arbitrary address.
Internal helper that stores the contract-specific insufficient-permissions revert message.
Modifier enforcing hasRole(role, _msgSender()) with _revertMsg as error string.
Public view returning whether an account is a member of a role.
Public function granting a role; requires caller to hold the role admin role.
Public function revoking a role; requires caller to hold the role admin role.
Public function allowing an account to renounce its own role.
Internal unchecked role grant intended for constructor/initializer use.
Internal function changing the admin role of a given role.
Private function adding a member to a role and emitting RoleGranted.
Private function removing a member from a role and emitting RoleRevoked.
Returns msg.sender, the primary source of caller identity in access checks.
Modifier setting inited = true and reverting if already initialized.
External interface function invoked on rootToken with fully attacker-controlled calldata.
Converts raw bytes into an RLPItem with length and memory pointer.
Decodes an RLPItem list into an array of RLPItems.
Decodes an RLPItem into a uint256.
Decodes an RLPItem into a bytes array.
Library helper that checks balance and forwards value via a low-level call.
Address receiving DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE during initialize.
Caller-supplied withdrawer address compared against topic1 of the log.
Caller-supplied address that is the target of the external setData call.
Raw RLP-encoded sidechain log supplied to exitTokens.
Decoded RLP item array of the outer log.
Decoded RLP item array of the log topics.
ABI-decoded payload extracted from the log and forwarded to rootToken.
Role identifier checked by the only modifier and by role management functions.
Account address being granted, revoked or renouncing a role.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
The only modifier evaluates hasRole(role, _msgSender()), making access dependent on caller identity.
grantRole authorizes the caller using _msgSender against the role admin role.
revokeRole authorizes the caller using _msgSender against the role admin role.
renounceRole requires account == _msgSender().
_grantRole emits RoleGranted with _msgSender() as the sender field.
_revokeRole emits RoleRevoked with _msgSender() as the sender field.
_setupContractId writes the composed string into _revertMsg.
The only modifier consumes _revertMsg as the require revert string.
initialize calls _setupContractId("CustomPredicate").
initialize calls _setupRole for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE.
initialize is guarded by the initializer modifier.
The initializer modifier sets inited = true, preventing re-initialization.
exitTokens is restricted by only(MANAGER_ROLE).
lockTokens is restricted by only(MANAGER_ROLE).
The only modifier invokes hasRole to validate permissions.
MANAGER_ROLE is the role argument fed into the only modifier guard.
MANAGER_ROLE is granted to _owner during initialize.
hasRole reads membership from the _roles mapping.
grantRole checks the caller with hasRole before granting.
revokeRole checks the caller with hasRole before revoking.
grantRole delegates to _grantRole.
revokeRole delegates to _revokeRole.
renounceRole delegates to _revokeRole.
_setupRole delegates to _grantRole without any caller check.
_setRoleAdmin writes the adminRole field of RoleData in _roles.
_grantRole adds the account to _roles[role].members.
_revokeRole removes the account from _roles[role].members.
The raw log bytes are converted to an RLPItem via toRlpItem.
The RLPItem is decoded into a list.
The decoded outer list is stored in logRLPList.
logRLPList[1] (topics) is decoded again with toList.
The topics sub-list is stored in logTopicRLPList.
Topics are converted to uint256 for signature and sender comparison.
logRLPList[2] is converted to bytes and ABI-decoded into data.
CUSTOM_EVENT_SIG is compared against topic0 inside exitTokens.
rootToken parameter is supplied by the caller of exitTokens.
withdrawer parameter is validated against topic1 inside exitTokens.
exitTokens calls toRlpItem on the supplied log.
exitTokens calls toList on the decoded log and on the topics item.
exitTokens reaches the external call Data(rootToken).setData(data).
The decoded data payload is passed as calldata to the external call.
The caller-controlled rootToken determines the target contract of the external call.
The external call executes arbitrary code in the attacker-chosen rootToken contract (Data.setData).
The invoked contract can reenter exitTokens or other manager-guarded functions during the external call.
Address.sendValue forwards the amount through the low-level recipient.call.
The low-level call gives the recipient contract control before sendValue returns.

normalization_plan.reason: _owner is a parameter consumed exclusively by initialize when granting roles.
withdrawer is a parameter used only inside exitTokens for the topic1 comparison.
rootToken is the caller-controlled target of the unsafe external call Data(rootToken).setData(data).
log is the parameter that exitTokens decodes with RLPReader.
logRLPList is a temporary local created and consumed inside exitTokens.
logTopicRLPList is a temporary local created and consumed inside exitTokens.
data is the local payload that flows directly into the unsafe external call.
role is the parameter consumed by the only modifier to select the required permission.
account is the parameter granted/revoked through grantRole and _grantRole.
